security.csp: default-src 'self' tauri:; script-src 'self' tauri:; style-src 'self' tauri: 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' tauri: data: blob:; connect-src 'self' tauri: ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Show file library for digital mixing desks
bundle.longDescription: Keep a library of mixing desk show files with version history. Inspect the I/O, channels, sends, buses, scenes and cues, generate PDF documentation, label strips and Companion pages, convert between Allen & Heath and Yamaha desks, and pull from or push to the live desk.
